title: More radioactive nuclei
hook: Change number of undecayed nuclei and predict expected activity.
misconception: expected activity stays fixed when number of undecayed nuclei doubles.
objective: Apply activity = λN to compare expected activity when number of undecayed nuclei changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a radioactive isotope with fixed decay constant, activity = λN. When number of undecayed nuclei doubles, expected activity becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model activity = λN; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a radioactive isotope with fixed decay constant, with a nonzero initial result. If number of undecayed nuclei triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on expected activity?
recall.why: Apply activity = λN under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
